description: Capability for the call indicator window (label `call-indicator`, created and destroyed only by the call-indicator thread, src-tauri/src/call_indicator.rs, T-130): listen to and stop listening to indicator://state and indicator://tick, invoke the three call_indicator_* commands its page uses, and start_dragging (the page's data-tauri-drag-region). Nothing else: the page never shows, focuses, moves, closes or destroys its window (a tao setter on the raw-shown window would hide or activate it, docs/decisions/overlay.md); least privilege, decision #45; app commands are ACL-checked per label, T-049, docs/decisions/ipc-acl.md.
